newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy insurance premium income up in H1 96 - Isvap.
newsitem.headline: Italy insurance premium income up in H1 96 - Isvap.

text.p: Italian insurance premium income showed an increase in the first half of 1996, especially in life business, but the rise was less than that seen in the first half of 1995, according to data from Italy's insurance watchdog Isvap.
In non-life business, premium income rose 6.5 percent to 20.456 trillion lire in the first half of 1996 from year ago levels, after a 7.6 percent rise seen in the first half of 1995.
In life business, premium income rose 13.8 percent to 10.157 trillion lire, against a rise of 18.2 percent one year ago.

Isvap figures are taken from Italian companies operating in Italy, representative groups in Italy of companies with headquarters outside the Europe Union, but not of companies with headquarters in other EU countries.
